reports.title: Labcorp Reports Strong 2026 Third Quarter Results; Raises Full Year 2026 Guidance

guidance.heading: Guidance for 2026
section: Labcorp is updating 2026 full year guidance to reflect its third quarter performance and full year outlook. The following guidance assumes foreign exchange rates effective as of September 30, 2026. Enterprise level guidance includes the estimated impact from currently anticipated capital allocation, including acquisitions, share repurchases, and dividends.
